_comment: One entry per task: `task` is the text the agent gets, `setup` prepares an empty folder (bash), `check` exits 0 when the task is solved (bash, run in the same folder after the agent). Replace them with your tasks and your scorer.

long-report-1.task: Run ./report.sh in this folder. Its last line is `TOTAL=<number>`. Write only that number to the file answer.txt.
long-report-1.setup:
printf '#!/bin/sh
for i in $(seq 1 40); do echo "row $i: nothing to report here"; done
echo "TOTAL=618"
' > report.sh && chmod +x report.sh
